# POSE v0.20.3

## Fixed

- The independent verification's extension-install check now installs into the instance it created. `pose extension install` acts on the current directory rather than on a target argument, so without a `cd` the check installed somewhere else and then asserted the rule was missing. Signature verification and tamper rejection were already passing against the published artifact; this was the remaining leg. (pose-verifier-extension-install-cwd)
